# Gym OS
> Complete gym management operating system for Indian gyms: WhatsApp automation, QR check-in, lead CRM, UPI collection, owner dashboard, branded website included. Built by Beyond Pixells, a product studio in India that
> builds sector-specific operating systems for local businesses. Flat monthly pricing, unlimited members.

## Facts
- India-native: WhatsApp-first automation, UPI payments, flat INR pricing
- No per-member fees; one-time setup + flat monthly subscription
- Every rollout includes a branded website, member/patient portal and owner dashboard
